rag_memory.name: RAG & Memory Context Engine

local_ai_reasoner.name: Prash Local AI Engine
local_ai_reasoner.description: Decoder-only GPT-style transformer built from scratch in PyTorch, loaded dynamically for offline reasoning tasks.

live_mode_perception.name: Live Mode Screen Perception
live_mode_perception.description: Continuous background desktop UIA scene graph observer, sending focus overlays and proactive suggestions.

desktop_automation.description: Simulates keyboard strokes, hotkeys, mouse clicks, and Playwright browser orchestration.

hand_gesture_control.name: Hand Gesture Cursor & Desktop Control
hand_gesture_control.description: Camera perception cursor controls using MediaPipe landmarker, tracking clicks, scrolling, and dragging.

self_healing_pipeline.name: Self-Healing Runtime Recovery
self_healing_pipeline.description: Intercepts runtime execution faults, diagnoses root cause, executes recovery scripts, and stores experience lessons.

mobile_companion_sync.name: Mobile Companion Gateway & Lockscreen
